item.title: GitHub Actions: Complete CI/CD Guide from Beginner to Production
item.description:
GitHub Actions: Complete CI/CD Guide from Beginner to Production

Writing code is only one part of software development.

Modern software teams automate everything:

  • Building applications
  • Running tests
  • Checking code quality
  • Creating Docker images
  • Publishing releases
  • Deploying applications
  • Sending notifications

GitHub Actions makes all of this possible without leaving GitHub.

Whether you’re building a personal portfolio or managing enterprise software, GitHub Actions helps you deliver software faster, more reliably, and with fewer mistakes.

item.title: Prompt Engineering for Authentic Historical Photo Restoration
item.description:
Prompt Engineering for Authentic Historical Photo Restoration

Prompt engineering plays an important role in AI-assisted restoration.

Small wording changes can dramatically affect the final image.

Weak Prompt

Restore this old photograph.

This leaves many important decisions to the model.

Strong Prompt

A better prompt specifies:

  • Damage detection
  • Identity preservation
  • Background reconstruction
  • Texture fidelity
  • Period accuracy
  • Composition preservation

This produces far more reliable results.

Key Instructions

Always include guidance such as:

  • Do not alter facial identity.
  • Do not change pose.
  • Preserve original framing.
  • Preserve clothing.
  • Preserve medals and decorations.
  • Avoid AI-art styling.
  • Avoid over-sharpening.
  • Maintain original textures.

item.title: Building a Reusable JSON Prompt Generator Template
item.description:
Building a Reusable JSON Prompt Generator Template

Writing JSON manually works for a few scenes.

Writing hundreds of prompts quickly becomes repetitive.

The solution is a reusable template.

This article explains how to design a flexible JSON prompt generator that can be adapted to almost any AI video generation platform.

Why Templates Matter

A reusable template offers several advantages:

  • Consistency
  • Speed
  • Fewer mistakes
  • Easier collaboration
  • Simple automation

Instead of starting from scratch every time, you only fill in the required fields.
